styles.name: Coat — MTC
styles.desc: MTC — Black Gents Coat . Long sleeves. Two mitred pockets. One chest pocket left side as worn. Back neck buggy. Centre back vent.
trims: NICKEL RING PRESS STUD 032B/B — MALE FITTING
NICKEL RING PRESS STUD 032B/C — FEMALE FITTING
NICKEL RING PRESS STUD 032B/AR — PRONG FITTING
Tibard centre fold label: Tibard Woven Centrefold Label (32x80mm)
Additional label: WHITE 25MM NYLON LABEL TAPE FOR TIBARD-PRINTED LABELS — 65% Recycled Polyester 35% Organic cotton 60 degree wash
THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S BLACK 09700 — cost per metre
mfg: MAKE COLLAR. FOLD IN HALF WITH RIGHT SIDES TOGETHER. JOIN ENDS. TURN THROUGH AND STITCH ALONG CUT EDGE TO SECURE PIECES.
SET LABELS TO BACK BUGGY AT CENTRE BACK.
OVERLOCK FRONT EDGES AND FACING SHOULDER. BACK BUGGY LOWER EDGE. CENTRE BACK VENT EDGES.
PRESS CENTRE FRONT FOLD
SET POCKET HEM. 1.5CM + 1.5CM DOUBLE TURNED AND TOPSTITCH AT 1.5CM.
SET LOWER POCKETS. SET 7CM IN FROM FRONT EDGE AND 24CM UP FROM CUT HEM EDGE.  EDGESTITCH IN POSITION.
SET CHEST POCKET. SET 7CM IN FROM FINISHED FRONT EDGE AND 14CM DOWN FROM FRONT STEP CUT EDGE.EDGESTITCH IN POSITION.
JOIN UP ON 5 THREAD - CENTRE BACK. SHOULDERS, COLLAR, SLEEVES, SIDE SEAM AND UNDERARM SEAM.
BACK NECK SEAM 6MM TOPSTITCHED AND RUN ONTO FRONT FOR 6CM TO SECURE FACING DOWN.
TACK FRONT FACING DOWN AT SHOULDER
PRESS CENTRE BACK SEAM AND VENT.
STRAIGHTEN CENTRE BACK SEAM AT BASE OF BACK VENT.
SET ANGLED STITCH LINE LENGTH 5.5CM AT TOP OF SPLIT AT CENTRE BACK SEAM. KICK PLEAT TO BE (12" /30CM)
BODY HEM DOUBLE TURNED AND TOPSTITCHED 1.5CM + 1.5CM
SLEEVE HEM  DOUBLE TURNED 1.5 + 1.5CM AND TOPSTITCHED 1.5CM
fin: SET TOP AND LOWER STUDS X 4  USE MARKER
BARTACK VERTICAL TOP OF POCKETS X 6 BARTACKS

BARTACK ALONG FRONT PANEL- LEFT SIDE AS WORN .VERTICAL  BARTACKS TO HOLD FRONT STUD PANEL DOWN  AND CONCEAL THE STUDS.  BARTACKS TO BE IN LINE WITH STUDS AND 3.6CM FROM FRONT FOLD EDGE. SET BARTACK ON TOP SIDE OF COAT TO GET GOOD SIDE OF BARTACK.
styles.brandPlace: MTC 7cm logo set to left chest as worn.
styles.note: Black gents coat for MTC, size 100, out of the costing app (SR0017, converted 2026-11-05). Same pattern as the storm grey COB0001 range. Added to the style master 11 Nov 2026.
